title: Seagain modpack

body:
Seagain SMP – Season 2 Performance Modpack

This modpack is made for the Seagain SMP Season 2 server and focuses entirely on performance, stability, and smooth multiplayer gameplay.
It includes the best optimization mods to boost FPS, shorten loading times, and reduce lag — all while keeping the vanilla experience intact.

🧩 Features:

	•	⚙️ High-performance optimizations — improved rendering, lighting, and entity processing for higher FPS.
    
	•	🚀 Faster startup & world loading — optimized resource handling and chunk generation.
    
	•	💡 Stable multiplayer experience — fewer frame drops and smoother combat or exploration.
    
	•	🌍 Server-ready setup — fully tuned for the Seagain SMP Season 2 configuration.
    
	•	🔧 Lightweight & compatible — works great on most systems; OptiFine is not required.
    

🎯 Why use this modpack?

If you play on Seagain SMP Season 2, this pack gives you the recommended performance setup for the best experience.
It’s also perfect for anyone who wants a clean, optimized vanilla client that runs faster and smoother than default Minecraft.

📦 Technical info

	•	Minecraft Version: 1.21.9
    
	•	Loader: Fabric
    
	•	Focus: Client-side performance
    
	•	Shader support: Compatible with Iris
